summary: We are delighted to present this exceptional 22-bedroom House in Multiple Occupation (HMO), which has recently undergone a full, high-quality refurbishment. Thoughtfully designed with both comfort and practicality in mind, this property offers modern living in a stylish setting. The property comprises 22 spacious, well-presented bedrooms, a number of which benefit from en-suite facilities. The bathrooms throughout the property are newly fitted, with a mix of private and shared options to suit different needs. Residents will also enjoy contemporary communal kitchens, complete with ample storage, high-spec appliances and sociable dining areas. Comfortable shared living spaces have been designed to promote modern co-living, and the property benefits from high-speed internet throughout. Refurbished to a professional standard, the house features fresh décor, new flooring and quality furnishings. Rents range from £425 to £525 per month.
